services.name: Home Shifting & Packing Service Variation 1
services.description: Reliable home shifting & packing services for a smooth and stress-free move.
excluded: Cost of premium packing materials (bubble wrap, crates)
Storage charges beyond 24 hours

process_steps.title: Pre-Move Survey
process_steps.description: Assessing volume, fragile items, and special requirements

process_steps.title: Packing
process_steps.description: Carefully packing all items with appropriate materials

process_steps.title: Loading & Transport
process_steps.description: Safely loading and transporting to the destination

process_steps.title: Unloading & Placement
process_steps.description: Unloading and placing items as per customer instructions

process_steps.title: Final Check & Clean-Up
process_steps.description: Verifying all items are delivered and removing packing waste

customer_setup: Sort and label boxes before the team arrives
Disconnect appliances 24 hours before moving day
Ensure parking access at both locations
aftercare: Check all items against inventory within 24 hours
Report any damage within 48 hours for warranty claim
services.expected_results: A damage-free, on-time move with all belongings safely delivered.
services.important_notes: Insurance coverage applies to standard household goods only; valuables should be declared upfront.
services.warranty: Free damage resolution within 48 hours of delivery if items are found damaged.

faqs.question: Do you provide packing materials?
faqs.answer: Yes, basic packing materials are included; premium options are available at extra cost.

faqs.question: Are my belongings insured during transit?
faqs.answer: Yes, all items are covered under transit insurance up to a declared value.

faqs.question: Can you move heavy or oversized furniture?
faqs.answer: Yes, our teams are equipped to move all types of furniture and appliances.

faqs.question: How do I track my shipment?
faqs.answer: You will receive a live GPS tracking link once the vehicle departs.

dos: Declare high-value items before the move for proper insurance coverage.
donts: Do not overload boxes — it increases the risk of damage.
tips: Label all boxes by room name to speed up unpacking.
